_doc: Which views of each review-page chart go into the paper. Key = <finding>#<section>. Each view: [suffix, [[button-row label, option text], ...], caption note]. An empty click list = the chart as it first draws. Sections not listed get their default view only. Read by scripts/paper/capture_figs.mjs. v3 (2026-10-20): views follow the researcher's notes on each graph across passes 1-5; where a note left the choice open, both are given.
f-personal-style#who-vs-what: In plain terms: telling taken from not taken
The same comparison as a ranking test (AUC); whiskers are 95\% intervals (people resampled).
f-personal-style#axis-scatter: Within a person, session to session
Within a person: change from session 1 to session 2.
f-personal-style#not-types: The people, mapped on the first two principal components.
Recurrence of groupings across sessions (adjusted Rand index).
f-size-decides#tactical: show a marker on each pair
With a marker on each pair at the rate for all plans in that size group.
f-size-decides#route-people: Each person's gap, mission size held.
f-size-decides#parallel: without time before the first action (grey)
Without the time before the first action.
f-size-decides#people: Each person compared with their own average.
f-manual-cards#position: Balanced for mission size, types, game, timing
Balanced for mission size, drone types, the gap between the cards, game, session and minute.
f-practice#speed: Strategic tier, sessions side by side.
all of session 1, then all of session 2
Strategic tier, all of session 1 then all of session 2.
Tactical tier, sessions side by side.
f-workload#raw-vs-adjusted: Both tiers together, raw with their expected rates (dashed).
Strategic tier, raw with the expected rate (dashed).
Tactical tier, raw with the expected rate (dashed).
f-workload#waited: Strategic tier: how long the mission had waited in the queue.
Tactical tier: how long the plan had been left open.
f-workload#spoken: Top: missions waiting at the overload moments; middle: strategy cards taken within $\pm$60\,s (observed $-$ expected); bottom: Suggest pressed within $\pm$60\,s (observed $-$ expected). Red line = observed mean; grey = 5,000 draws of the same number of random utterances from the same sessions.
f-flaw-odd#event: All missions, every pair of decisions, observed.
f-flaw-odd#by-index: Noticers against never-said, session 1 then session 2.
f-flaw-odd#spoken: Strict remarks: all missions against one- and two-type missions.
Strict and any remark, side by side
Strict and any remark, side by side.
f-tier-trust#stated-revealed: Use measured as keeping the plan unmodified.
Use measured as pressing Suggest at all.
